name: Swine’s Head (Teamwork, Combat)
body:
You are skilled in the rare but deadly Swine’s Head formation, a flying wedge of heavily armed northern warriors.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Wall*, Shieldwall Breaker

Benefit(s): You may run or charge and still enjoy the benefits of the Shield Wall feat.
